newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on higher call rates.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on higher call rates.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 43.2900/2950 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday, helped by a sharp hike in call rates, dealers said.

The local unit opened at 43.2900/2960 per dollar and retained the edge with market players paying overwhelming attention to trade in call money. Call money rates closed at 12 to 14 percent against the previous 5.5-6.5 percent.
A temporary liquidity shortfall hit some banks as they invested more than two billion taka on the central bank bills auctioned on Wednesday. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
